head.t: MiniMed launches its smallest automated insulin delivery system in Europe
head.x: MiniMed has begun commercial shipments of its new MiniMed Flex system across Europe, marking the launch of the company’s first app-controlled insulin pump and its smallest automated insulin delivery (AID) system to date.
